time-capsule.label: Time Capsule
time-capsule.description: Fame/h when every item in service was built before 1985 and the session runs 45 minutes or longer.

one-man-band.label: One Man Band

mods.stash_intro: A mod is a component, and the bench fits the one you hand it — it cannot make one. Mods come off gear you scrap and off the Trader's counter, and they go on at the value they already carry: nothing is re-rolled and nothing is charged.

mods.reroll_intro: A re-roll is the one job here that spends parts. It buys a brand-new value from the mod's range, and whatever comes up replaces what the mod is worth now — there is no keeping the better of the two.
mods.remove_intro: Taking one off costs {{fame}} Fame and frees its slot. The mod comes off the instrument for good: it is not put back in your stash, it cannot be fitted anywhere else, and the level it was worth goes with it.
mods.reroll_hint: Pays this bill again for one fresh roll between +{{min}} and +{{max}}. It replaces +{{points}} either way — {{odds}}.

tuner.label: Tuner
tuner.why: Reads the bare string, so nothing may colour the signal ahead of it.

filter.label: Filter
filter.why: Sweeps a clean signal. Behind the dirt it sweeps the fizz instead.

compressor.label: Compressor
compressor.why: Evens out the pick attack before anything downstream amplifies it.

fuzz.label: Fuzz
fuzz.why: Wants the pickups almost first-hand — buffers ahead of it choke it.

overdrive.label: Overdrive
overdrive.why: Grit on a clean signal, and the pedal a distortion is stacked onto.

distortion.label: Distortion
distortion.why: The hardest clipping sits at the end of the dirt section.

boost.label: Boost
boost.why: Pushes a tone that is already dirty. In front, it only adds volume.

eq.label: EQ
eq.why: Shapes the finished dirt before the time effects ever hear it.

modulation.label: Modulation
modulation.why: Moves a settled tone around. Order within the family is taste.

delay.label: Delay
delay.why: Repeats the finished sound. Ahead of the dirt it repeats mush.

reverb.label: Reverb
reverb.why: The room the whole rig is played in, so it is always last.

empty.label: Nothing Wired
empty.note: Put a pedal on the board and the order you put it in starts paying.

single.label: One Pedal
single.note: A chain needs somewhere for the signal to go next. Add a second pedal.

book.label: By The Book
book.note: Every cable runs into the pedal that belongs next. This is the order the craft asks for.

one-off.label: One Cable Off
one-off.note: One pedal is standing in the wrong place. Everything else is right.

rough.label: Rough Wiring
rough.note: Two cables run backwards through the chain.

spaghetti.label: Spaghetti
spaghetti.note: The signal crosses itself all over the board.

power.label: Power
power.patch_hint: Plug in everything the brick still has a hole for
power.dead_pedal_note: A pedal with no power adds no rig level and earns no Fame.
